description: This source file implements a command-line interface (CLI) tool for a wizard workflow in the OpenClaw macOS application. It parses command-line options, manages WebSocket connection with a gateway, and facilitates user interaction for wizard steps including prompts, options, and responses.

classes.name: GatewayWizardClient
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing WebSocket connection, request-response communication, and authentication with the wizard gateway server.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a WizardCliOptions instance.

methods.name: runWizardCommand
methods.description: Main async function orchestrating the wizard workflow, including setup, interaction, and cancellation.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection with the gateway server.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request with method and parameters to the gateway and awaits the response frame.

methods.name: decodePayload
methods.description: Decodes the payload of a response frame into a specific decodable type.

methods.name: sendConnect
methods.description: Performs the initial connect handshake with device info and authentication.

methods.name: waitForConnectChallenge
methods.description: Await the connect.challenge event to retrieve a nonce for device authentication.
